item.description: Tuesday was a breezy, partly sunny day in the Valley.Rain showers moved through during the early morning, bringing .08" of rain at Phoenix Sky Harbor, and generally around .10" to .20" across the Valley.The high country saw light snowfall above 6,000 ft and rain showers below. item.title: Changes to Arizona law could impact historic neighborhoods
item.description: An Arizona bill looks to strike a balance between Phoenix's history and its future, with proposed changes to the middle housing law. The law that passed last year was meant to address skyrocketing housing costs, but some say it threatens the state's history.
